name: flipper-codex-buddy
description: Use a Flipper Zero as a physical remote and feedback device for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Control Codex and receive status alerts on Flipper Zero.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex lifecycle hooks to a Flipper Zero over USB or Bluetooth for approvals, commands, sound, vibration, and status feedback.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Flipper Codex Buddy for physical status notifications and approvals.
